_comment: aterm EFFECTS baseline (docs/DESIGN-card-engine-2026-10-19.md lane B0): per scene (episode, flowing, settled, typing, scroll), the GPU time as a reference full-repaint frame's p50 over the scene's (_gpu_rel), the reference's own against a blank full repaint (ref_text_gpu_rel), and the CPU work of the producer, the CPU raster and the GPU encode as frames per 10^9 instructions retired (_per_ginsn). BIGGER-IS-BETTER. The absolute figures and the pass-economy ablation are in docs/measured/effects-baseline-2026-10-19.md. Re-record with targo --unverified verify perf --record effects. Re-recorded 2026-10-20, and again that day when the card scenes took the card's line (its ink and star, as claude_card lays them) and the scroll scene a reply's distinct lines (aterm-bench 744ef96818): the episode's CPU raster, and the scroll's emit and encode, are those scenes' new work (docs/measured/card-engine-b3-2026-10-20.md, the third round). Re-recorded 2026-10-23 when the typing scenes moved from the bare glow engine (CursorGlow::tick) to the cursor family a window presents (EffectsPipeline::cursor_step on the frame's cells): the letter guard's per-pixel compositing is now priced, and is most of typing_emit (it is why typing_emit_per_ginsn reads 45, not 838). On 2026-10-24 the flowing scene (the card's flow after its intro, with prose typed under it: each step drawn, each key between two steps replayed) joined the gated keys, so the flowing card's emit, raster, encode and GPU time are judged and not only reported: its four floors are box-bfa4e9e0bd17f9a7's (M4 Pro 14c) record that day, and the other sixteen stay the M5 Max box's. On 2026-10-25 the flowing card's emit became flowing_emit_mean_per_ginsn, its frames over all their instructions, in place of flowing_emit_per_ginsn, its median frame's: a run's 64 frames are 32 step draws and 32 key replays, so the median of the five runs' 320 was the costliest of 160 replays and read 12,000 to 20,700 on unchanged code. Its floor is m11's (M4 Pro 14c), the median of four effects_harness runs that day (9,012 to 9,069, load 44 to 89); the other nineteen are unchanged.
